messages:
miriam: Quick heads-up — I'm about to make a small routing/threshold tweak before handing off for the weekend. Doing this to reduce noisy auth-rate pages from integration test traffic.

alex: what's the change exactly?

miriam: TL;DR: temporarily raise prometheus alert `AuthHighRate` warning threshold 150/s -> 220/s for 36h, route warning-level alerts to `#eng-oncall-low` instead of `#eng-oncall`, keep `critical` -> `#eng-oncall` and PagerDuty. I'll open a PR and add a runbook note. No escalation policy changes.

jang: paste the alert rule diff pls

miriam: ```yaml
- alert: AuthHighRate
  expr: sum(rate(auth_requests_total[1m])) > 150
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: warning
+ # temp weekend noise reduction
+  expr: sum(rate(auth_requests_total[1m])) > 220
```

infra-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482 — Alertmanager config + playbook update

sam: will this affect paging for oncall rotations? also can we add a short runbook note about reversion

miriam: No change to PD escalation. I added `revert_at: 2026-03-22T17:00:00Z` comment to the PR and pushed a line in `playbooks/oncall-routing.md`. I'll schedule a revert job for Mon 10:00 PT.

olivia: tagging @alex — approving deploy window?

alex: approved. I'll be monitoring for 20m after apply. :thumbsup:

miriam: Applying the change now (will post status). If anyone sees missing critical pages, ping me directly. Also left a checklist in the PR: 1) apply, 2) confirm alerts in #eng-oncall-low, 3) check PD incidents, 4) schedule revert.

infra-bot: deploy succeeded: Alertmanager reloaded (commit 9f3a2b4). No failures reported.

miriam: Confirmed routing looks good in grafana alert history. Watching for 1h. Revert job scheduled for Mon 2026-03-22 17:00Z. Thanks — handing off to @alex for overnight coverage.

alex: taking handoff. I'll escalate if anything odd shows up.

jang: noted — updated my calendar. Good call on the temp tweak.
